issues.detail: The 2016 GSVM research does not provide a verified signature or entrypoint for SC2 5.0.16.97563; the profile contains no executable hooks.
issues.nextAction: Perform non-invasive tracing in an approved isolated debug window and only enable a hook after a current signature is independently verified.

issues.detail: A fresh approved debug SC2 window on port 5911 was launcher-owned, hash-matched, injected successfully, and closed after the handshake evidence was captured.

resolved.detail: LLVM-MinGW libunwind was linked and copied beside the native artifacts; the fixture binaries now start successfully.
The isolated fixture completed injection, HELLO, STATUS, and SHUTDOWN with hook_enabled=false.

residual_risks.detail: No VM execution, Galaxy bytecode replacement, editor bridge, or in-game WYSIWYG update path is implemented in this foundation stage.
